name: original_backfill_log
command:
if test -f /tmp/backfill_delisted.log; then stat --format='%n %s %y' /tmp/backfill_delisted.log && sha256sum /tmp/backfill_delisted.log && head -n 4 /tmp/backfill_delisted.log && tail -n 12 /tmp/backfill_delisted.log; else printf 'NOT_FOUND /tmp/backfill_delisted.log
'; fi
